title: Access Fob and Lockout Service Charges by Floor Plan
content:
Access fobs and lockout calls are service charges of the Apartment Home Lease. The fob allowance at move-in and the number of lockouts answered without charge differ by floor plan; the prices do not.

| Floor plan | Fobs issued without charge at move-in | Charge per lost, damaged or additional fob | Lockout charge, 8:00-18:00 Monday-Saturday | Lockout charge, any other time | Lockouts answered without charge in the trailing 365 days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | 2 | $75.00 | $50.00 | $95.00 | 0 |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 2 | $75.00 | $50.00 | $95.00 | 0 |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | 3 | $75.00 | $50.00 | $95.00 | 0 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 4 | $75.00 | $50.00 | $95.00 | 0 |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 5 | $75.00 | $50.00 | $95.00 | 0 |
| Penthouse Residence | 5 | $75.00 | $50.00 | $95.00 | 2 |

## Definitions

- **Fobs issued at move-in** — access fobs issued without charge at move-in.
- **Fob charge** — the charge for each lost, damaged or additional access fob, per fob.
- **Business-hours lockout** — a lockout answered between 8:00 and 18:00 local time, Monday through Saturday.
- **After-hours lockout** — a lockout answered at any other time, including any time on a Sunday.
- **Free lockouts** — lockouts answered without charge within the trailing 365 days.

## Points of reading

**Does any floor plan other than the Penthouse Residence include free lockouts?** No; the allowance is 0 on the other five floor plans and 2 on the Penthouse Residence.

**Hypothetical:** a lockout answered at 19:30 on a Tuesday falls outside 8:00-18:00 and is priced at the after-hours figure of $95.00; one answered at 10:00 on a Saturday is priced at $50.00. The times are example inputs.
